dependencies.mapping: For each sampled positive compact convex body, apply inclusion monotonicity to the centered ball of positive radius at an own-interior point. Its energy is its volume by the centroid equality. Use the same fact’s E≤|K| upper bound. No dependency on the simultaneous chart lemma is needed, since U≥Ψ and source contacts are explicit assumptions.
